notes: weak pole (max 11.6). Card: 'les' x5, ' Med', 'son', 'erge', 'ham'. Probe: Amersham 0.75, Wellesley 0.54, Vet Med 0.61, aubergine 0.60, but Tottenham 0.01, so the label may be too broad. Near misses use single-token place names.
